subject: Rule 2: cloud edits to Mac-owned build-tick files on claude/build-tick-followup-1593 (the #1593 follow-up) and what changes for the loaded job at merge
body: Cloud edits to Mac-owned files are on the Hub at claude/build-tick-followup-1593 (pushed 01:13:41Z at 5ab68e86; LANE_COORDINATION rule 1 / protocol rule 6; this is the rule-2 announcement). It is the cloud's follow-up to #1593's review findings M1-M5, L1-L3 and the transcribedFrom note, built test-first and adversarially reviewed twice; round 3 is fixing the two remaining LOWs (the installer's logical cd lets a symlinked-dir + .. path escape the outside-the-checkout rule; the exit trap does not take down a foreground triage session) and a PR opens after the landing refute, to land under DR-037 (SAFETY_MACHINERY). Files: scripts/mac/build-tick.sh, scripts/mac/build-tick-stages.mjs, scripts/mac/install-build-tick.sh, scripts/mac/install-launchd.sh, docs/agent/scheduled-routines.json (the mac-build-tick row), docs/LANE_COORDINATION.md. What changes for the running Mac job the moment it merges, because the launcher extracts mainline's build-tick.sh every run: (1) it heartbeats on every exit path to artifacts/agent-heartbeats/mac-build-tick.json through lane-deliver, and the row carries heartbeatPath + cadenceToleranceHours, so a silent build tick becomes a reported stall; (2) the origin-down hand fires once at >= 12 h by wall clock, not after 144 runs, and undelivered hands are retried on the next successful step 0; (3) an admitted run that ended in a hand or a fail is followed by a 3 h gap before the next admitted run (deferrals keep retrying every 5 minutes); (4) L3: the run verifies the pnpm on launchd's PATH against package.json's packageManager and REFUSES every admitted run on a mismatch - if that is the case on your Mac, the tick stops building (one deduplicated hand a day) until you set SG_BUILD_TICK_PATH_PREFIX to the directory holding the pinned pnpm and re-run bash scripts/mac/install-build-tick.sh --force; (5) the installer now takes the stage-runner wiring from the environment or a host-local env file outside the tree, writes it into the plist's EnvironmentVariables, and refuses to overwrite a loaded plist whose ProgramArguments or EnvironmentVariables differ unless --force; (6) install-launchd.sh --status reads the LOADED plist and exits 1 with UPDATE NEEDED on a StartInterval mismatch. Nothing for you to do before the merge; after it, run bash scripts/mac/install-build-tick.sh --status once and read what it says about pnpm and the loaded plist. The row's heartbeatSince is stamped at the branch's last commit, so the cloud lands within 3 h of it or re-stamps. Separately: your build tick's hand 2026-10-23-could-not-read-current-tasks-from-mainline-redac - the witness is back intermittently (the 00:27:38Z tick acted, 00:48:10Z and 01:08:41Z ran quiet naming "objective: escalate", while 00:32:48Z, 00:53:19Z and 01:13:50Z deferred on the host lock), so the intake refusal depends on which heartbeat is latest; the design option (accept the last clean tick within staleAfterHours) is a row in the local-brain contract under build, not a silent loosening. The hand stays yours to clear.
